items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: The interviewee only confirms the interviewer's statement about Eddie Harris recording with Johnny Armand; no personal interaction or relationship between the interviewee (Tim Kelly) and Johnny Armand is described.

ctx.x: Eddie, Eddie does play some clarinet on there.

Not the guitar player. The guy who wrote one of the pieces on there. He's a guitarist. Yeah. Eddie, of course, he disclaims being in shape on clarinet. And I heard him record with Johnny Armand on clarinet. Oh, he? He said he hadn't played it for nine years or something like that.
